resolved_or_reduced: OS NGD Alternate Address stores alternative labels for the current UPRN and can contain both official aliases and historic development labels
An Alternate Address row is not a separate property and an addressstatus of Historic does not make the current UPRN historic
The primary feature type retains the official current address while alias and historic labels remain in the related component
Alternate Address related-component rows contain no geometry and must join to the matching feature type by UPRN
Other Classification provides matched VOA Council Tax and Non-Domestic Rate context beyond Local Authority classification
VOA Other Classification is available only for England and Wales and requires featuretypeversiondate parity with its address feature
Other Classification schemeversion changes data type between schema v1/v2 and v3 and must not be silently coerced
A VOA classification match is supplementary usage or rating context and not title ownership or exact parcel evidence
The Postal Address related component was discontinued for latest address schema v3.0 and replaced by the Royal Mail Address feature type
Older maintenance schemas v1.0 and v2.0 can still contain Postal Address related components so mixed-schema deliveries can double count delivery points
Royal Mail Address and Street Address do not receive UPRN-keyed related components because their primary keys are UDPRN and USRN
Ofcom distinguishes premises unable to obtain decent broadband from fixed or fixed-wireless networks from premises unable to obtain affordable decent broadband after satellite options
Spring 2026 reported 39000 premises without decent fixed or fixed-wireless access and about 4000 without affordable decent broadband after lower-priced satellite availability
Ofcom excluded about 7000 additional commercial premises from its affordable-USO estimate because their connectivity status may differ and the lower-priced packages are marketed as residential
Affordability classification depends on the stated monthly price threshold and product eligibility and is not a delivered fixed-line coverage attribute
BDUK January 2026 NR OMR classifications are a point-in-time supplier-submission outcome and can differ from Public Review intervention-area classifications
Not all active suppliers participated in the January 2026 NR OMR so Grey Black White and Under Review counts cannot be treated as a complete timeless market census
Only White premises are subsidy targets while Under Review premises may enter deferred scope pending a further White or Grey determination
HMLR states every registered title has at least one index polygon while pending registration applications can have a title number without estate interest or class of title
A pending Title Descriptor record must not be treated as a fully registered title or as proof that a current polygon and UPRN association are available
